card.name: Non-stationary linear contextual bandit (related AEL adaptation)

task.name: Non-stationary linear contextual bandit (related AEL adaptation)
task.description: Optimize a policy on a locally specified five-arm linear Gaussian contextual bandit with changing arm weights. Related to AEL’s non-stationary setting; it does not recreate the source Bernoulli rewards, hidden eleventh arm or reflection mechanism.
task.contract: class Policy: __init__(self, n_arms, dim); select(context) -> arm; update(context, arm, reward). Non-stationary linear rewards. Score: mean per-round reward
